info.title: Toy Mart BD API
info.description: Toy Mart BD API v1, grouped by audience: storefront, admin, webhooks. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`, schema `ProblemDetails`); branch on `type`, never on `title`/`detail`. Routes marked with the `Idempotency-Key` header replay a completed 2xx response for 24h (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

tags.name: Storefront
tags.description: Next.js storefront server — static server token or customer Sanctum token.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Admin SPA — Sanctum cookie session, CSRF token on every write.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Courier and payment-gateway callbacks — signature-verified, idempotent on the provider event id.

post.summary:
Wrong email, wrong password and a deactivated account all get the same 422
on `email`, so the response never reveals whether an account exists or its
state. Throttled by the `login` limiter (5/min per IP)

post.summary:
`POST /products/{product}/duplicate` — a draft copy with a new slug and new SKUs
(barcodes are not copied); needs catalog.create

`POST /products/{product}/images` — `multipart/form-data`; appended last, primary
when it is the product's first image. 201 with the image (`processing`)

422.description: Not a JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF by content, over 10 MB or 8000 px, an embedded payload, or undecodable (`validation-error` on `file`)

post.summary: `POST /products/{product}/images/reorder` — returns the images in the new order

get.description:
`?tree=1` returns the whole tree, archived categories included, as
`{ data: Category[] }` where each node carries `children` recursively, in tree
order. Filters and sorts do not apply to the tree.

Otherwise a cursor-paginated flat list in tree order. Filters:
`filter[search]` (name, name_bn or slug contains), `filter[status]` =
`active|archived`, `filter[parent_id]` = an id or `root`. Sorts: `name`,
`-name`, `created_at`, `-created_at` (default: tree order). Anything else is a 400.

`GET /categories/tree` — the mega menu: active categories with
`show_in_menu`, at most three levels, in tree order. A hidden or archived
category hides its whole branch

`GET /categories/{slug}` — one active category with its breadcrumbs (root
first, itself last) and its active subcategories (menu visibility aside)

get.description:
Lists are comma-separated. Unlisted parameters, filters or sorts and
malformed values are a 400. Availability ("in stock") arrives with the
inventory tables (P4-INV).
get.summary:
`GET /products` — active, published products with at least one active
variant, 24 per page by cursor, with disjunctive facet counts in
`meta.facets` (each facet ignores its own filter) and the result-set size in
`meta.total`

parameters.name: filter[category]
parameters.description: Category slug; includes every active descendant category.

parameters.name: filter[age]
parameters.description: A child's age in months (0–216): age_min_months ≤ age ≤ age_max_months, both inclusive, null bounds open.

parameters.name: filter[price_min]
parameters.description: Lowest listing price (the minimum active variant price), inclusive; a decimal string.

parameters.name: filter[price_max]
parameters.description: Highest listing price, inclusive; a decimal string.

parameters.name: filter[price_band]
parameters.description: Price bands, comma-separated (any of): 0-500, 500-1000, 1000-2500, 2500-5000, 5000- (min inclusive, max exclusive).

parameters.name: filter[gender]
parameters.description: Comma-separated (any of): unisex, boys, girls. `unisex` also matches products with no gender.

parameters.name: filter[educational]
parameters.description: Only educational (true) or only non-educational (false) products.

AttributeType.description: `product_attributes.type`. `color` values carry a `color_hex` swatch; `select` and `text` do not.
AttributeType.title: AttributeType

locale.description: No `users.locale` column yet; null means "use the request locale".

CategoryStatus.description: `categories.status`. A category is archived rather than deleted, because products reference it through `primary_category_id` and `category_product`.
CategoryStatus.title: CategoryStatus

CropProductImageRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images/{image}/crop` — `{ x, y, width, height }` in the
image's current pixels (`width` × `height` on the resource). Needs catalog.update.
CropProductImageRequest.title: CropProductImageRequest

Gender.description: `products.gender` — nullable: most toys need no gender at all.
Gender.title: Gender

last_courier_sync.description:
Courier sync lands in Phase 6 (Fulfilment). Always null until then, and never
counted towards `status`.

MoveCategoryRequest.description:
`POST /categories/{category}/move` — `{ parent_id, position }`. The category
becomes the child of `parent_id` (null = a root) at sibling index `position`
(0-based; past the end means last). Up/down keeps the parent and changes the
position; indent/outdent changes the parent.
MoveCategoryRequest.title: MoveCategoryRequest

type.description: Stable machine-readable problem type, e.g. `https://toymartbd.com/problems/validation-error`. Branch on this.

options.description:
The selected values of each variant-defining attribute, derived from the
active variants. Empty for a simple product.

ProductStatus.description: `products.status`. `draft` is invisible to the storefront; `active` is live once `published_at` has passed; `archived` is retired but kept (orders reference it).
ProductStatus.title: ProductStatus

ProductType.description: `products.type`. A simple product has exactly one (default) variant; a variable product has one variant per combination of its selected attribute values. Either way the variant is the unit of inventory (DATABASE-DESIGN §1.1).
ProductType.title: ProductType

cost_price.description: Current replacement cost; only with catalog.view_cost.

attribute_values.description: One value per variant-defining attribute; empty for a simple product.

RelationType.description: `product_relations.type` (DATABASE-DESIGN §3.1). `age_progression` is its own type, not a flavour of upsell: an upsell is a better version of the same toy; an age progression is the next toy, for a child who has outgrown this one.
RelationType.title: RelationType

ReorderAttributeValuesRequest.description:
`POST /attributes/{attribute}/values/reorder` — `{ ids: [3, 1, 2] }`, every value
id of the attribute exactly once, in the new display order.
ReorderAttributeValuesRequest.title: ReorderAttributeValuesRequest

ReorderProductImagesRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images/reorder` — `{ ids: [3, 1, 2] }`, every image id
of the product exactly once, in display order. Needs catalog.update.
ReorderProductImagesRequest.title: ReorderProductImagesRequest

StoreAttributeRequest.description:
`POST /attributes`. `type` is `select` (default), `color` (values carry a swatch)
or `text`. When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`).
StoreAttributeRequest.title: StoreAttributeRequest

StoreAttributeValueRequest.description:
`POST /attributes/{attribute}/values`. `slug` is unique within the attribute and
generated from `value` when omitted. `color_hex` (`#RRGGBB`) is kept only for a
colour-type attribute.
StoreAttributeValueRequest.title: StoreAttributeValueRequest

StoreBrandRequest.description:
`POST /brands`. When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`),
ASCII-transliterated (rule 37) and made unique.
StoreBrandRequest.title: StoreBrandRequest

StoreCategoryRequest.description:
`POST /categories`. Appended as the last child of `parent_id` (omit or null for a
root). When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`). At most
three levels deep; an active category under an archived parent is a 409.
StoreCategoryRequest.title: StoreCategoryRequest

StoreProductImageRequest.description:
`POST /products/{product}/images` — `multipart/form-data`: `file` (JPEG, PNG, WebP
or AVIF by content, ≤ 10 MB, ≤ 8000 px per side), optional `alt_text`,
`alt_text_bn`, `variant_id`, and an optional `crop[x|y|width|height]` rectangle
in the source image's (EXIF-oriented) pixels. Needs catalog.update.
StoreProductImageRequest.title: StoreProductImageRequest

StoreProductRequest.description:
`POST /products` — needs catalog.create. Setting the initial prices is part of
creating; a `cost_price` anywhere in the document needs catalog.view_cost.
When `slug` is omitted it is generated from `name` (or `name_bn`).

specifications.description: Label → value pairs ("Material" → "ABS plastic"), a JSON object.

StoreProductRequest.title: StoreProductRequest

UpdateAttributeRequest.description:
`PATCH /attributes/{attribute}` — every field optional; only the fields sent
change. Changing `type` away from `color` clears the values' swatches.
UpdateAttributeRequest.title: UpdateAttributeRequest

UpdateBrandRequest.description:
`PATCH /brands/{brand}` — every field optional; only the fields sent change.
`slug: null` (or omitted) keeps the current slug: a rename never moves the URL.
`is_active: true` restores an archived brand.
UpdateBrandRequest.title: UpdateBrandRequest

UpdateCategoryRequest.description:
`PATCH /categories/{category}` — every field optional; only the fields sent
change. `slug: null` (or omitted) keeps the current slug. The parent and order
change only through `POST /categories/{category}/move`.
UpdateCategoryRequest.title: UpdateCategoryRequest

UpdateProductImageRequest.description:
`PATCH /products/{product}/images/{image}` — any of `alt_text`, `alt_text_bn`,
`variant_id` (null detaches), `is_primary` (`true` only). Needs catalog.update.
UpdateProductImageRequest.title: UpdateProductImageRequest

UpdateProductRequest.description:
`PUT /products/{product}` — needs catalog.update. The whole document, variant
matrix included; `slug` null (or omitted) keeps the current slug, `relations`
omitted keeps the curated relations, `cost_price` omitted keeps a variant's cost.

Field-level abilities, enforced where the domain sees what changes (403 otherwise):
changing a selling price or adding a variant needs catalog.update_price; sending
any `cost_price` needs catalog.view_cost.

specifications.description: Label → value pairs ("Material" → "ABS plastic"), a JSON object.

UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

VariantStatus.description: `product_variants.status`. A variant is archived, never deleted: stock movements and order lines reference it.
VariantStatus.title: VariantStatus

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key (a UUID v4 is ideal), 8–255 printable ASCII characters. Retrying with the same key and body replays the stored 2xx response for 24h with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`; while the first request runs, 409 `request-in-progress`.
